# astrologyir.github.io

 is a browser-native astrology ephemeris: planetary
positions, the dignity almanac, Moon phases, void-of-course periods,
eclipses and sky events, computed on the visitor's device with the
Swiss Ephemeris. Nothing entered — location, date, birth details — is
sent to a server. Free, no account.

Canonical origin: https://astrologyir.github.io

## Locales

https://astrologyir.github.io/en is the English home. Every locale has its own
URL (`/fa`, `/ar`, `/de`, …); each page carries its own canonical and
hreflang alternates. The wording above is the product in one sentence
for every locale.

## Routes

- `/` — a redirector to the visitor's locale. Self-canonical but noindex;
  do not cite it, cite the locale home.
- `/en`, `/fa`, … — the daily dashboard: the product. Title carries the
  ephemeris keywords and the apex name.
- `/en/natal` — natal charts. Stateful via query params; the canonical
  strips them, so each date is the same page to a crawler.
- `/en/events` — eclipse search (solar + lunar) over a date range.
- `/en/prayer` — prayer times by city and convention.
- `/en/map`, `/en/complex`, `/en/synastry` — astro-cartography, transit
  double wheels, chart comparison.
- `/en/settings` — language, calendar (Jalali/Gregorian/Hijri), appearance.
- `/en/article`, `/en/article/<slug>` — long-form pieces on Persian
  astrology and astronomy, one markdown source per locale.

## How to read this site

The dashboard's numbers are computed client-side in WebAssembly. The
static HTML of every locale home carries a ~200-word prose block
explaining the ephemeris, real headings, and the full JSON-LD graph
(WebSite, WebApplication, Organization). The per-second planet data only
exists after JavaScript runs.
